title: Kaamelott lorem ipsum — AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway REST API
description: Returns a random Kaamelott quote on each GET request. No external dependencies — quotes are bundled directly in the Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A GET request to /kamelott triggers the Lambda function, which picks a random quote from a bundled JSON dataset of 2537 Kaamelott quotes and returns it as JSON.
This pattern deploys one Lambda function and one API Gateway REST API.
